<!doctype html><html lang="es"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>Tiendas Referidos Navideños</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Manrope:wght@300;400;600&family=Quicksand:wght@700&display=swap">
<style>
/* Navidad Is Magic 2026: head Coral, bandas Pino por región, fondo Snow, tarjetas Crudo */
:root{
  --snow:#F9F5F2; --crudo:#EDE7DE; --tinta:#241C16; --gris:#6B6156;
  --coral:#E8462F; --coral-prof:#C03A24; --pino:#1C6B4A; --lila:#C9CCF4;
  --line:#E2DAD0;
  --title:'Quicksand',system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif;
  --body:'Manrope',system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif;
  color-scheme:light;
}
body{margin:0;background:var(--snow);color:var(--tinta);font-family:var(--body);font-weight:400;font-size:16px;line-height:1.45}
.wrap{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;padding-left:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));padding-right:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px))}

/* HEAD */
.head{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--coral);color:var(--snow)}
.head canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none}
.head .wrap{position:relative;padding-block:24px 24px}
.eyebrow{font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:13px}
.head h1{margin:0;font-family:var(--title);font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:clamp(32px,5.6vw,54px);line-height:.88;letter-spacing:-.04em;text-wrap:balance;max-width:12ch}
.head p{margin:0;font-weight:300;font-size:clamp(16px,1.8vw,19px);max-width:42ch}
.head-grid{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.15fr) minmax(0,.85fr);align-items:center;gap:24px}
.head-text{display:grid;gap:10px;min-width:0}
.logo{display:block;width:clamp(140px,16vw,180px);height:auto;margin:-14px 0 -8px -10px}
.art{position:relative;height:240px;min-width:0}
.art img{position:absolute;height:auto;max-width:none}
.o-gift{width:36%;right:27%;bottom:2%;transform:rotate(-6deg);filter:drop-shadow(-14px 26px 32px rgba(110,26,12,.48))}
.o-star{width:25%;right:2%;top:0;transform:rotate(10deg);filter:drop-shadow(-10px 18px 24px rgba(110,26,12,.48))}
.o-snow{width:20%;left:8%;top:10%;transform:rotate(-8deg);filter:drop-shadow(-8px 14px 18px rgba(110,26,12,.48))}
.o-ball{width:16%;right:8%;bottom:6%;transform:rotate(6deg);filter:drop-shadow(-8px 14px 18px rgba(110,26,12,.48))}
@media (max-width:760px){.head-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.art{height:150px;max-width:320px;width:100%;justify-self:end}}

/* FILTROS */
.controls{display:grid;gap:16px;padding-block:28px 8px}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.chip{font:inherit;cursor:pointer;border:2px solid var(--tinta);background:transparent;color:var(--tinta);border-radius:999px;padding:10px 18px;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:baseline}
.chip strong{font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:13px}
.chip small{color:var(--gris);font-size:13px}
.chip[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--tinta);color:var(--snow)}
.chip[aria-pressed="true"] small{color:inherit;opacity:.8}
.chip:focus-visible,.search:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--lila);outline-offset:2px}
.search{font:inherit;width:100%;max-width:440px;box-sizing:border-box;padding:12px 14px;border:2px solid var(--crudo);border-radius:4px;background:#fff;color:var(--tinta)}
.count{color:var(--gris);font-size:14px;margin:0}

/* REGIONES */
.region{margin-top:32px}
.band{background:var(--pino);color:var(--snow)}
.band .wrap{padding-block:18px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px 24px;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between}
.band h2{margin:0;font-family:var(--title);font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:clamp(26px,4vw,36px);letter-spacing:-.035em;line-height:.9}
.band .meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px 18px;font-size:15px}
.band .meta b{font-weight:600}
.tablebox{overflow-x:auto}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;min-width:640px}
th{text-align:left;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gris);font-weight:600;padding:14px 12px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--tinta)}
td{padding:12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);vertical-align:middle}
td.t{font-weight:600}
td.n,th.n{text-align:center;width:110px}
.n span{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;min-width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--coral);color:var(--snow);font-weight:600}
.brand{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.08em;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:999px;white-space:nowrap;background:var(--lila);color:var(--tinta)}
.brand.is{background:var(--crudo)}
.state-row td{background:var(--crudo);font-weight:600;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:8px 12px;color:var(--tinta)}
.empty{padding:40px 0;color:var(--gris)}
footer{margin-top:48px;background:var(--pino);color:var(--snow);background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.22) 0 1px,transparent 1px 14px)}
footer .wrap{min-height:150px;box-sizing:border-box;padding-block:28px;display:grid;gap:22px;align-content:center;font-size:14px}
.marcas{display:block;width:min(560px,100%);height:auto}
</style>

<style>@media print{.controls{display:none!important}td{padding:5px 10px!important}.state-row td{padding:4px 10px!important}.n span{min-width:22px!important;height:22px!important;font-size:12px}.head .wrap{padding-block:24px 24px!important}.region{margin-top:18px!important}footer{margin-top:20px!important}table{min-width:0}.region{break-inside:auto}.band{break-after:avoid}tr{break-inside:avoid}body{-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact;print-color-adjust:exact}}</style></head><body><header class="head">
  <canvas id="snow" aria-hidden="true"></canvas>
  <div class="wrap head-grid">
    <div class="head-text">
      <img class="logo" src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," alt="Navidad Is Magic">
      <div class="eyebrow">Programa de referidos</div>
      <h1>Tiendas participantes</h1>
      <p>Consulta en qué tiendas hay vacantes eventuales esta temporada, organizadas por región.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="art" aria-hidden="true">
      <img class="o-snow" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="">
      <img class="o-star" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="">
      <img class="o-gift" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="">
      <img class="o-ball" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="">
    </div>
  </div>
</header>

<main>
  <div class="wrap controls">
    <div class="chips" role="group" aria-label="Filtrar por región" id="chips"></div>
    <input class="search" id="q" type="search" placeholder="Busca una tienda, estado o VCD" aria-label="Buscar">
    <p class="count" id="count"></p>
  </div>
  <div id="list"></div>
</main>
<div style="height:48px"></div>

"Ruth Miranda", "vcr": "Leonardo Rocha", "n": 1}, {"r": 3, "t": "TM Merida Cen 2", "m": "Todomoda", "e": "Yucatán", "vcd": "Ruth Miranda", "vcr": "Leonardo Rocha", "n": 1}];
const REG = {};
DATA.forEach(d=>{(REG[d.r] ||= {vcr:d.vcr,rows:[],n:0}); REG[d.r].rows.push(d); REG[d.r].n += d.n;});
const regs = Object.keys(REG).map(Number).sort();
let active = 0;
try{ active = +(localStorage.getItem('reg')||0) || 0; if(!REG[active]) active=0; }catch(e){}
const esc = s => String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c]));
const norm = s => String(s).normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase();
const total = DATA.reduce((a,d)=>a+d.n,0);

function chips(){
  const items = [{k:0,label:'Todas',sub:`${DATA.length} tiendas · ${total} eventuales`}]
    .concat(regs.map(r=>({k:r,label:`Región ${r}`,sub:`${REG[r].rows.length} tiendas · ${REG[r].n} eventuales`})));
  document.getElementById('chips').innerHTML = items.map(i=>
    `<button class="chip" type="button" data-k="${i.k}" aria-pressed="${i.k===active}"><strong>${i.label}</strong><small>${i.sub}</small></button>`).join('');
}
function render(){
  const q = norm(document.getElementById('q').value.trim());
  let html='', shown=0, ev=0;
  regs.filter(r=>!active||r===active).forEach(r=>{
    const rows = REG[r].rows.filter(d=>!q || norm([d.t,d.e,d.vcd,d.m].join(' ')).includes(q));
    if(!rows.length) return;
    shown += rows.length; const n = rows.reduce((a,d)=>a+d.n,0); ev += n;
    let body='', last='';
    rows.forEach(d=>{
      if(d.e!==last){ body += `<tr class="state-row"><td colspan="4">${esc(d.e)}</td></tr>`; last=d.e; }
      body += `<tr><td class="t">${esc(d.t)}</td><td><span class="brand ${d.m==='Isadora'?'is':''}">${esc(d.m)}</span></td><td>${esc(d.vcd)}</td><td class="n"><span>${d.n}</span></td></tr>`;
    });
    html += `<section class="region"><div class="band"><div class="wrap"><h2>Región ${r}</h2>
      <div class="meta"><span>VCR <b>${esc(REG[r].vcr)}</b></span><span><b>${rows.length}</b> tiendas</span><span><b>${n}</b> eventuales</span></div></div></div>
      <div class="wrap tablebox"><table><thead><tr><th>Tienda</th><th>Marca</th><th>VCD</th><th class="n">Eventuales</th></tr></thead><tbody>${body}</tbody></table></div></section>`;
  });
  document.getElementById('list').innerHTML = html || `<div class="wrap empty">No encontramos tiendas con esa búsqueda. Revisa la ortografía o elige “Todas”.</div>`;
  document.getElementById('count').textContent = `Mostrando ${shown} tiendas · ${ev} eventuales`;
}
document.getElementById('chips').addEventListener('click',e=>{
  const b=e.target.closest('.chip'); if(!b) return;
  active=+b.dataset.k; try{localStorage.setItem('reg',active)}catch(e){}
  chips(); render();
});
document.getElementById('q').addEventListener('input',render);
chips(); render();

/* nieve */
(function(){
  const c=document.getElementById('snow'), x=c.getContext('2d');
  const still = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  let W,H,f=[];
  function size(){W=c.width=c.offsetWidth*devicePixelRatio;H=c.height=c.offsetHeight*devicePixelRatio;
    f=Array.from({length:Math.round(W*H/9000/devicePixelRatio)},()=>({x:Math.random()*W,y:Math.random()*H,r:(Math.random()*2.4+0.8)*devicePixelRatio,s:Math.random()*.5+.2,w:Math.random()*6}));}
  function draw(){x.clearRect(0,0,W,H);x.fillStyle='rgba(249,245,242,.7)';
    f.forEach(p=>{x.beginPath();x.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r,0,7);x.fill();
      if(!still){p.y+=p.s*devicePixelRatio;p.w+=.01;p.x+=Math.sin(p.w)*.3;if(p.y>H){p.y=-4;p.x=Math.random()*W}}});
    if(!still) requestAnimationFrame(draw);}
  size(); addEventListener('resize',()=>{size(); if(still) draw();}); draw();
})();
</script>
</body></html>
